about: The one licence rule for the acceptance runner's own packages (package 3.1), the third component the licence check covers (hard rule 2; build plan package 0.4). The same permitted list as builder/licence-rule.json and templates/next/licence-rule.json; no exceptions. Every installed package, and every package the lock file lists, must carry a licence on the permitted list. An exception would need the owner's written approval of one named package for one named use, recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md.
